transcript: Speaker A: भाषा ही है यार, भाषा तो... just a medium to convey what you feel. [It's just a language, man, language is... just a medium to convey what you feel.] Spoken English start kijiye, full masti karke. [Start spoken English, with full fun.] Spoken English theek hai, karte hain. Ajeeb si cheez hai, demand acchi hai. Mere khayal se hai zaroorat. Kai jagah English seekhne ki zaroorat hai logon ko, jo seekhna chahte hain. [Spoken English is fine, let's do it. It's a strange thing, but the demand is good. In my opinion, there is a need. In many places, people need to learn English, those who want to learn.] Speaker B: English speaking seekhna hai toh PW Talk app abhi download karo. [If you want to learn English speaking, download the PW Talk app now.]
on_screen_text: Alakh Sir launches English Speaking App. Spoken English. PhysicsWallah Presents PW Talk English Speaking App. RIVA 24x7 AI Practice Partner. Roleplays Real Life Situations Practice. 300+ Video Lessons 3-5 Mins Reels type. 4.8 RATING. 25 Lakhs+ Downloads. Want To Improve Your Spoken English? PW TALK. DOWNLOAD NOW PW TALK APP. GET IT ON Google Play.
summary: Alakh Pandey highlights the high demand and necessity of learning spoken English. The ad then demonstrates the key features of the PW Talk app, including its AI practice partner Riva, interactive roleplays, and bite-sized video lessons, ending with a CTA to download the app.
